title: centaurea phrygia subsp. bosniaca
intro: Centaurea phrygia subsp. bosniaca, commonly known as Balkan cornflower, is a species of flowering plant in the dandelion tribe within the sunflower family. The plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties that may help to reduce pain, improve wound healing, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea phrygia subsp. bosniaca are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been shown to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antioxidant activities. However, further research is needed to fully understand the plant's medicinal properties and potential applications.
